captions.detailed: This 3D model appears as a solid, flat cylinder or puck-like object with a smooth, continuous outer wall. On one side of the outer vertical face, there is a small, subtly debossed monogram logo. The top and bottom faces are completely flat and circular, concealing the complex internal gear mechanism of the planetary bearing inside.
captions.instruction: Design a 3D-printable planetary gear bearing with herringbone gears as a single pre-assembled piece. The model should feature an outer ring, an inner sun gear with a hexagonal shaft hole, and multiple planet gears, with customizable parameters for outer diameter, thickness, gear teeth count, and clearance.
captions.factory: The design uses a custom mathematical involute gear module to construct 2D gear profiles. These profiles are extruded into helical gears using linear_extrude with a twist parameter, and mirrored/unioned to create herringbone gears. The assembly combines a main outer cylinder (differenced with an internal herringbone ring gear and a monogram), a central sun gear with a hexagonal cutout, and a loop of planet gears positioned around the center using a coordinate rotation and translation.
